test_name: Verify Navigation Through Main Menu Categories
description: This test verifies that users can navigate through the main menu categories (Men, Women, Accessories) and reach the corresponding product category pages.
steps: Verify that the page navigates to 'https://atid.store/product-category/men/'.
Verify that the page navigates to 'https://atid.store/product-category/women/'.
Verify that the page navigates to 'https://atid.store/product-category/accessories/'.
edge_cases: Verify the behavior when the menu links are clicked multiple times in quick succession.
Test with a slow network connection to ensure the links load the correct pages.
Check if the links work when accessed using keyboard navigation.
Verify that the links are functional in different browsers and devices.
Ensure the links are accessible for screen readers.
data_requirements: The menu links must be present and enabled.
The menu links must have the correct URLs.
dependencies: The main menu must be present on the home page.
The category pages must be accessible.
The website must be online and functional.
api_interactions: Monitor any API calls triggered during the navigation process.
Ensure that the category data on the destination pages is fetched successfully.
performance_metrics: Measure the time taken to load each category page.
Check the responsiveness of the menu links.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure that the menu links are navigable using keyboard shortcuts.
Verify that the menu links have appropriate ARIA labels.
Check the menu links for sufficient color contrast.
